hero.introPart2: and holding a bachelor’s degree. Passionate about coding and a quick learner, I enjoy working with design patterns and building robust architectures. Rigorous, organized, and naturally curious, I adapt quickly and am ready to add value to your team from day one.

eminaCoiffure.description: Online booking web application (React / Vite SPA, Mobile-First) and brand showcase for a hairdressing and beauty salon specializing in 100% natural treatments. BaaS architecture powered by Firebase (Firestore with strict security rules to isolate client bookings), automated confirmation emails via the Resend API, continuous deployment (CI/CD), DNS, and DDoS protection via Cloudflare Pages.

innovEvents.description: A containerized client-server solution (Docker Web and API) centralizing an agency's event management through a reliable CRM, automated PDF quote generation, and collaborative task tracking.

gottaPostal.description: A high-performance web application built with React and Hugo, fully containerized with Docker and deployed via Cloudflare, providing secure access to an SMTP server dedicated to sending emails, managing campaigns, and conducting authorized phishing awareness simulations.

clarsi.description: Contributed to the development of the FFRandonnée solution (ASP.NET Core API & React Next.js Client) dedicated to subscribers and members of the French Hiking Federation. Front-End development in React and Next.js from mockups, focusing on rendering performance, hybrid rendering, and a seamless user experience. Data modeling and creation of HTTP services in ASP.NET Core for secure REST API integration and consumption. Implementation of multi-step forms secured with strict Zod validation, fine-grained role-based access control, and collaboration within an Agile team.

sosit.description: Designed and developed a SaaS solution in the Transport & Logistics sector across two major versions. On V2 (Web & Mobile SaaS): cross-platform development on a shared codebase using Angular and Capacitor, creation of reusable UI components (HTML5/SCSS), secure REST API integration in a multi-tenant context, and active contribution to CI/CD pipelines and containerized Docker builds. On V1 (Construction Site Management - .NET 10): data modeling, EF Core migrations within a Clean Architecture, C# services implementing the Result Pattern, Blazor interfaces, multi-step forms, automated PDF generation (waybills/consignment notes), and rigorous unit and integration testing.

eminaCoiffure.description: End-to-end design and development of an online booking web application (React / Vite, Mobile-First approach) and brand showcase for a real hair salon in Lille (live client project in production). Backend-as-a-Service architecture powered by Firebase (Firestore with strict security rules to protect client data), smart time-slot blocking based on the selected service, automated email confirmations via the Resend API, continuous deployment (CI/CD), DNS configuration and security via Cloudflare Pages, as well as search indexing and local SEO monitoring (Google Search Console).

gottaphish.description: Contribution to the development and continuous improvement of the GottaPhish cybersecurity platform, dedicated to phishing awareness training and prevention through dynamic, personalized campaigns. Full development and Docker deployment of a web application (GottaPostal), built with Hugo, providing access to an SMTP server. Modernization of the main application's end-to-end test suite using Playwright and Node.js.

optitmome.description: Improved customer satisfaction and internal productivity through rigorous needs analysis and smooth communication, achieved by integrating PHP Laravel and WordPress mockups to deliver an improved UX/UI.

cite.description: Design and development of a cross-department collaborative tool, working directly with the technical team and the client. This project involved a responsive UI/UX overhaul, the implementation of role-based dynamic views, and the creation of custom components (search engine, modal windows, icon picker), all backed by rigorous version control on Git/GitHub and concluded with the final technical demo presented to the client.

studi.description: Advanced training focused on designing robust and secure web architectures with an Angular specialization, relational database management, and full-stack development.

m2i.description: Intensive professional training in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) with C# and .NET 10, focused on designing and building robust REST APIs with ASP.NET and Entity Framework Core.

afpa.description: Intensive training in web fundamentals, responsive integration, and building dynamic web applications with modern frameworks.
